# ADR-001 — Separate game and one-way progression
Accepted product direction: ZBattle is separate, with independent battle/AFK progression. Copy pets from ZPet without removal. No writes back. Stable source IDs, preserve battle progression on reimport, once-per-milestone bonuses.
Provisional foundation: native Java/platform Views/local versioned profile matching ZPet references; minimal dependencies. Gameplay domain/save/AFK/import architecture needs review; no backend chosen.
All master appearances share skill/equipment access. Ten illustrations uncreated; exact bonus balance/import protocol unresolved.
